### Niagen Bioscience Expands Tru Niagen® Retail Footprint with GNC and Sam’s Club


August 20, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/770776702/files/doc_news/Niagen-Bioscience-Expands-Tru-Niagen-Retail-Footprint-with-GNC-and-Sams-Club-2026.pdf)


*Leading NAD+ healthy aging supplement reaches new health-conscious consumers at nearly 300 GNC and Sam’s Club locations across 44 states combined*


LOS ANGELES--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Niagen Bioscience, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenbioscience.com%2F&esheet=54592472&newsitemid=20260820988403&lan=en-US&anchor=Niagen+Bioscience%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=18843408c42a1981241135dd0ebe68c8) (NASDAQ: NAGE), the global authority on NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) with a focus on the science of healthy aging, today announced that Tru Niagen®, the number one healthy-aging NAD-boosting supplement in the United States†, is now available at GNC and Sam’s Club retail locations and online at[www.gnc.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.gnc.com&esheet=54592472&newsitemid=20260820988403&lan=en-US&anchor=www.gnc.com&index=2&md5=d9c2f282fc04e3e32745bb4727ed6b80) and[www.samsclub.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.samsclub.com&esheet=54592472&newsitemid=20260820988403&lan=en-US&anchor=www.samsclub.com&index=3&md5=5fff9a64470808f47fc68fbe6de27a1d) .


Tru Niagen is now available at nearly 300 GNC and Sam's Club retail locations across 44 states combined.


“Expanding Tru Niagen across GNC and Sam’s Club strengthens our retail footprint and puts the category-leading NAD+ supplement in front of new consumer audiences,” said Rob Fried, CEO of Niagen Bioscience. “These partnerships reflect the growing demand for credible, science-backed healthy aging solutions.”


With this latest retail expansion, Tru Niagen is now available in nearly 300 retail locations across 44 states combined. At GNC, shoppers can find Tru Niagen Beauty, the first-ever beauty supplement in the US featuring Niagen (patented nicotinamide riboside or NR) designed to support skin elasticity and the appearance of hair, skin, and nails, along with Tru Niagen 300mg 30-count bottles in store and online. Sam’s Club shoppers can purchase Tru Niagen 300mg 120-count bottles in store and online.


Supporting cellular function and healthy aging, Tru Niagen is clinically shown to increase NAD+ levels and help sustain them over time. It’s powered by Niagen (patented nicotinamide riboside, or NR), the most well-researched, efficient, and high-quality NAD-booster available. NAD+ is an essential coenzyme vital to cellular health, mitochondrial function, cellular energy production, and DNA repair. Embodying the highest scientific and quality standards, Tru Niagen is backed by more than 45 human clinical studies, over 500 published scientific studies, and more than 60 patents worldwide, and is recognized by the world’s most rigorous regulatory bodies.


To purchase Tru Niagen on GNC and Sam’s Club e-commerce platforms visit[www.gnc.com/brands/tru-niagen](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.gnc.com%2Fbrands%2Ftru-niagen&esheet=54592472&newsitemid=20260820988403&lan=en-US&anchor=www.gnc.com%2Fbrands%2Ftru-niagen&index=4&md5=4d182422f3095c4a280e4c5dacba0811) and[www.samsclub.com/tru-niagen](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.samsclub.com%2Fip%2FTru-Niagen-NAD-Supplement-300mg-Vegetarian-Capsules-120-ct%2F19902316868%3FclassType%3DREGULAR%26from%3D%2Fsearch&esheet=54592472&newsitemid=20260820988403&lan=en-US&anchor=www.samsclub.com%2Ftru-niagen&index=5&md5=c8ed440b21d04ad47dc941881fa025bc) . For more information about the science behind Tru Niagen, visit[www.truniagen.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.truniagen.com&esheet=54592472&newsitemid=20260820988403&lan=en-US&anchor=www.truniagen.com&index=6&md5=41f96782be771d79b93780b591b937df) .


**About Niagen Bioscience**


[Niagen Bioscience, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenbioscience.com%2F&esheet=54592472&newsitemid=20260820988403&lan=en-US&anchor=Niagen+Bioscience%2C+Inc.&index=7&md5=c6dec1c4b52a0fe43b1b5052cad3d1fa) (NASDAQ: NAGE) is the global authority in healthy aging and NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) science. As a trusted pioneer of NAD+ discoveries, Niagen Bioscience™ is dedicated to advancing healthspan through precision science and innovative NAD+-boosting solutions.


The Niagen Bioscience team, composed of world-renowned scientists, works with independent investigators from esteemed universities and research institutions around the globe to uncover the full potential of NAD+. A vital coenzyme found in every cell of the human body, NAD+ declines with age and exposure to everyday lifestyle stressors. NAD+ depletion is a key contributor to age-related changes in health and vitality.


Distinguished by state-of-the-art laboratories, rigorous scientific and quality protocols, and collaborations with leading research institutions worldwide, Niagen Bioscience sets the gold standard for research, quality, and innovation. There’s a better way to age.


At the heart of its clinically tested product portfolio is Niagen® (patented nicotinamide riboside, or NR), the most efficient, well-researched, and high-quality NAD+ booster available. Niagen powers the Company’s consumer supplement, Tru Niagen®, the number one NAD+ boosting oral supplement in the United States† (available at[www.truniagen.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.truniagen.com&esheet=54592472&newsitemid=20260820988403&lan=en-US&anchor=www.truniagen.com&index=8&md5=37d756655909c42c6470f49eaef999df) ), and Niagen™ Plus, featuring pharmaceutical-grade intravenous (IV) and injectable Niagen products ([www.niagenplus.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenplus.com&esheet=54592472&newsitemid=20260820988403&lan=en-US&anchor=www.niagenplus.com&index=9&md5=b34506847e5e214da94765a8f756c5b1) ). Pharmaceutical-grade Niagen IV and injections are compounded and distributed by U.S. FDA-registered 503B outsourcing facilities and are available exclusively at clinics with a prescription. NAD Pharmaceuticals Corp., the Company’s wholly owned subsidiary focused on developing therapies for accelerated aging and rare genetic diseases, is conducting research on NB4168, a differentiated small molecule.


Niagen Bioscience’s robust patent portfolio protects NR and other NAD+ precursors. Niagen Bioscience maintains a website at[www.niagenbioscience.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenbioscience.com&esheet=54592472&newsitemid=20260820988403&lan=en-US&anchor=www.niagenbioscience.com&index=10&md5=89c2a91e70c537adade11f5e88c548e8) , where copies of press releases, news, and financial information are regularly published.


† *Based on revenue per largest U.S. e-commerce marketplace (Jan. 2025 – Dec. 2025)*
